# Dependencies for the CI suite tier (static level only).
#
# The static suite needs pytest and the dialect library. It does not import the
# simulation, FMI, or SSP stack, so requirements.txt (the full runtime bundle)
# is not installed here. pycps_sysml pulls its two pinned dependencies
# (sysmlpy, pyssp-sysml-definitions) transitively.
pytest==9.2.0
pycps_sysml @ https://github.com/pyssporg/pycps_sysml/releases/download/v0.4.0/pycps_sysml-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl
